key_concepts: Meiosis reduces chromosome number by half from diploid to haploid
Gametogenesis is the formation of sex cells or gametes
Spermatogenesis in testes produces four haploid sperm cells
Oogenesis in ovaries produces one mature haploid ovum and polar bodies
Fertilization restores the diploid chromosome number in the zygote
Humans inherit 23 chromosomes from each parent, giving a zygote 46 chromosomes
Sperm structure includes a nucleus-bearing head, enzyme-containing acrosome, and energy-pr
Primary oocytes pause in prophase I until puberty and complete meiosis II after fertilizat
Polar bodies degenerate and shed excess haploid chromosome sets
Meiosis maintains the standard chromosome number of a species across generations
Chromosomal abnormalities during meiosis can cause conditions such as Down syndrome, Patau
